title: OpenPaleoGlossary
description: Plain-English definitions of the terms used in paleontology, from open-paleo/glossary.

categories.description: The categories, in the order the glossary lists them.

terms.description: The terms, by id: lowercase words joined by hyphens, such as "nomen-dubium".

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the output follows. A new major version is a breaking change.

license.description: The license, as an SPDX id.

term_count.description: How many terms the glossary holds.

id.description: The category's folder under terms/, such as "anatomy/vertebrae".

description.description: What the category covers, in one sentence.

term.description: The term as the glossary lists it.

category.description: The id of the category it belongs to.

forms.description: Every spelling that links to this term in text, the term itself first. Match them case-insensitively, as whole words; no form belongs to two terms.

definition.description: A plain-English definition of one or two sentences.

etymology.description: Where the word comes from, such as its Latin or Greek roots.
